validation.notes: Native suite includes parser, sampler lifecycle, notification fallback, subprocess bounds and generic desktop behavior. Parser tests reran after a Clippy-only refactor. Existing TAURI callback warnings remain in the passing interface tests. Earlier full-interface and Mac-adapter results remain in the prior receipt and are not represented as newly run here.

actual_hushed.notification_only_trial: User reported no detection; ringing interval was not captured.
compatibility_fixes: Ignore unrelated tab-indented history after Analytics.
Resolve the Binder service process with dumpsys --pid telecom; a guessed Telecom process name is absent on this image.
actual_hushed.listener: Stopped immediately when user could not repeat the call.
actual_hushed.limitation: A registered idle provider does not prove that live Hushed calls use Android Telecom; a real incoming/answer/end trial is still required.

android_telecom_fixture.binding_observation: The same exported protected service bound with no action or a fixture action, but binding with android.telecom.ConnectionService failed. Account registration and permission to add an incoming call were verified. No positive current-call row was captured; this does not establish how real Hushed behaves.
android_telecom_fixture.fixture_normalization: Native framing, enabled flags, component and capability tokens retained; account/group IDs and extras replaced with documented placeholders. Synthetic lifecycle files are explicitly named and labeled.
android_telecom_fixture.cleanup: Fixture removed, current calls empty, validation index 1 stopped. User instance 0 left running unchanged.

limitations: Only the exact Hushed Telecom component or supported notification metadata is recognized.
Unknown or failed snapshots preserve lifecycle without presenting stale evidence.
Call-state detection does not establish audio capture routing.
